name: logs
title: logs
summary: Diagnostics from every subsystem, grouped by code with counts, subjects and fixes; filter by code, severity, subject or origin, and read new ones with since.
html:
Diagnostics from every subsystem, grouped by code with counts, subjects and fixes; filter by code, severity, subject or origin, and read new ones with since.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: core
  • MCP: ara_logs

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
sinceOnly entries new or repeated after this cursor (cursor of a previous call).
codesOnly these codes (ARA1302, ARA-EXP-AND-007).
severityMinimum severity (default info).
entityOnly entries about this entity (record ID or address prefix).
subjectsOnly entries about these subjects (entity:e_8b21, asset:@meshes/crate.glb, system:physics.step, pass:gbuffer, module:Gameplay).
originOnly entries caused by engine, human, agent or agent:<name>.
textOnly entries whose message contains this text.
groupGroup entries by code with counts, subjects and the best fix (default true); false lists them one by one.
budgetApproximate size of the text answer in characters (default 2000).
limitAlso return up to this many entries (newest kept) as JSON entries, with the grouped summary. Without it the answer is the text: what agents need.
